enemy_sprites.note: Primitive meshes; silhouettes differ by shape only

telegraph_poses.note: Telegraphs rely on the coloured status rings and body tilts

wet_ground.note: One flat ground colour; no flagstone, moss or puddles

props.note: Containers are plain boxes; no barrels, banner, timbers or leaning shield

torch_light.note: A warm torch pool on a dark world with fast falloff is there; the cold blue-grey ambient and wet highlights aren't

fire_vfx.note: Flames are emissive spheres; no flipbooks

backdrop.note: No mist or pines beyond the walls

palette_discipline.note: Mostly muted, but the status rings add saturated colour that isn't fire, blood or rot

pack_grid.note: The pack is a text list

pack_detail.note: No detail pane; Use/Drop buttons sit on each row

hud_minimal.note: Six bars and several text lines top-left, plus a key-help panel
